card.text: Largest body of the Datura family.

sources.label: Rosaev & Plávalová (2015), New members of Datura family
sources.quote: A group of minor asteroids associated with the largest body Datura(1270) is of particular interest because it has enough known members and resides in the inner part of the main asteroid belt and is easy to observe.

introduction.text: G. Van Biesbroeck found Datura at Williams Bay in 1930. It is the largest body of the Datura family in the inner main belt.

sources.label: JPL Small-Body Database
sources.quote: 1270 Datura (1930 YE); Discovered 1930-Dec-17 by Van Biesbroeck, G. at Williams Bay; orbit class: Main-belt Asteroid
